summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a director/PDMR shareholding notification under the RELX PLC ShareSave Plan 2023, where PDMR Rosemary Thomson was granted options over 922 ordinary shares at GBP 19.728 per share, with a nil exercise price. The transaction occurred on 2026-06-17 outside a trading venue. This is a routine equity grant disclosure, not a special situation; it involves no material corporate event such as acquisition or restructuring.
